checks.perFingerBaseline: Three failing assertions before new fingers received their own geometry and EQ inset

behaviour: Waveform, EQ, filter and FX opt into captured window-space touch frames.
Held contacts retain their mapping through panel origin/size changes, including full collapse.
New fingers capture current geometry; ended/cancelled contacts cannot return.
EQ captures the inset for each finger. Waveform operations retain the gesture source span.
Compact decks reject new contacts without closing existing FX/EQ gates.
Actual viewport/orientation changes and app interruption still cancel explicitly.
Crossfader fills the entire gap from A Play bottom to B FX top, with no vertical track padding. A/B markers move onto the FX buttons; button anchors stay fixed.
limits: Physical overlapping gestures, UIKit delivery and listening require Erik acceptance.
The host check exercises production geometry and gesture state, not physical iPad input or audio rendering.
Mouse fallback keeps its existing cancellation behaviour; iPad is the only active target.
